Looking at the initial steps, Poetry_Expert asked for the poem text, and Literature_Expert tried to perform a web search using a Python script. The script failed with an error, so Computer_terminal was called in to execute it, but it also failed, resulting in a traceback error.

Then, Literature_Expert switched tactics and used the Poetry Foundation link to get the poem text directly. They provided the full text, and Poetry_Expert analyzed it, identifying Stanza 3 as having indented lines. Literature_Expert agreed with this analysis.

So, the mistake was made by Literature_Expert at step 3 when the web search script failed, leading to an incomplete or incorrect result.
